limitations.statement: Catalog entry only; execution is disabled in this MVP.
No admitted capsule binds exact CPython, its standard library, and the pinned walkaround distribution.
walkaround operates a mutable work-tree session and .walkaround directory; EWB's current single-artifact subject cannot represent that lifecycle.
Session mutation, receipt inspection, optional Git discovery, and organ execution require distinct future adapters and capabilities.
An unsigned ADMITTED receipt records passage through a frozen session contract; it does not verify correctness, security, producer identity, or authority.
